messages:
kevin: drafting the external status update for the degraded API event. keeping it short and nontechnical.

olivia: please avoid internal jargon like "route table". say "routing configuration error" or "configuration error".

maria: quick ask: do we commit to a public RCA or only notify impacted customers? we should be consistent.

sarah: legal: publish a redacted RCA for incidents with broad customer impact. if there are sensitive details, provide private RCAs to affected customers. i'll review final copy for redaction.

kevin: proposed status copy: "At 03:10 UTC we detected degraded availability due to a routing configuration error affecting a subset of customers. Service was restored by 03:36 UTC. Mitigations were applied and we are publishing a redacted postmortem."

olivia: add owners and timing: "Redacted postmortem targeted within 72 hours (owner: kevin). A 30-day verification of mitigations will be completed (owner: maria)."

maria: ok to own 30-day check. i'll add a verification checklist to the postmortem doc.

kevin: also calling out recurrence: we've had two routing incidents in last 6 months. adding: "We are investigating systemic deployment processes to prevent recurrence."

sarah: good. legal will confirm that sentence is fine. also note: do not list partner or customer names in the timeline.

incident-bot: Postmortem items created: INFR-3550 (canary rollout, owner: olivia), INFR-3551 (pipeline checks, owner: kevin), INFR-3552 (30d verification, owner: maria).

olivia: final step: i'll post the status update and circulate the customer email draft to @sarah and @kevin for review. publishing in ~15m. :thumbsup:
